features.title: Semantic Warden combat cues
features.gap: Warden telegraphs exposed attack and response but no stable non-color semantic cue for presentation/accessibility.
features.adaptation: Evade, Brace and Punish cue enum is emitted with every authoritative telegraph.
features.acceptance: RiftSlash/EchoBurst map to Evade, GravityPulse to Brace, StaggerOpening to Punish without changing combat timing.

features.title: Learned attack catalog
features.gap: Existing phase practice did not retain which specific attacks the player had actually faced.
features.adaptation: Accepted ranked/practice resolutions mark only the resolved attack as learned; rejected inputs cannot fabricate knowledge.
features.acceptance: AttackLearned is false initially, true after accepted resolution, and invalid enum queries fail closed.

features.title: Per-attack training performance
features.gap: Practice recorded no attack-specific attempts, successes or best success streaks.
features.adaptation: Each resolved attack records bounded attempts/successes/best streak and last-seen phase across attempt resets.
features.acceptance: Success/failure update the correct attack only, counters are bounded, and ranked records/unlocks remain separate.

features.title: Weakest learned attack practice recommendation
features.gap: Existing phase practice required the player to decide what to rehearse without game-domain evidence.
features.adaptation: Read-only recommendation selects the learned attack with most failures, then lower success rate, and reports its last-seen phase and response.
features.acceptance: No recommendation exists before learning; recommendation is deterministic and non-mutating.

features.title: Exact action timing feedback
features.gap: Resolve reported outcome but not whether the response choice was correct separately from whether it was on time.
features.adaptation: Accepted actions report responseMatched plus signed timingMarginSeconds against the authoritative window.
features.acceptance: Boundary is zero, early is positive, late is negative; invalid/nonfinite inputs remain rejected before mutation.

features.title: Post-mistake response coach
features.gap: A failed Warden response did not explain whether the player chose the wrong action, acted too late, or missed the punish opening.
features.adaptation: Last accepted mistake retains attack, expected response, semantic cue, reason, authoritative window and observed timing for presentation by future UI.
features.acceptance: Wrong response, late correct response and missed punish are distinguished; rejected input never creates coaching evidence.
features.sentiment: corroborating player anecdotes, not consensus; existing ZZZ tutorial acknowledged and exact current post-mistake breakdown resolution unestablished
